title: Lore Keeper
description: This project adds an easy and intuitive way to add lore to your world!
body:
# Lorekeeper

Lorekeeper is an in-game compendium and discovery system built for creators, modpacks, and servers. You can create custom books, organize information into categories and entries, add images, and let players uncover knowledge naturally as they play.

---

## Create Your Own Compendiums

Build custom collections of information for your world. This can include Beastiaries, Regions, Lore, Quests, Guides and so much more! 

Organize everything into categories and detailed entries with custom titles, descriptions, and images!

---

## Discovery and Progression

Knowledge does not have to be available immediately. By simply traveling around a world players can discover regions, unlock entries in the compendium, reveal hidden information about that area and even progress through exploration!

This makes it perfect for adventure maps, RPG experiences, and progression-focused gameplay. Explore and have fun with it! 

---

## Features

Lorekeeper includes simple tools to help creators build and manage their own in-game information system. There is a simple difference between admins and default players that allows for full customization! 

Features include:

* Custom compendiums
* Categories and entries
* Entry titles, descriptions, and images
* Category images
* Discovery-based unlocking
* Region-based discoveries
* Discovery popups
* Player progress tracking
* External image support
* Admin/editor tools
* Teleport buttons for entries with saved locations
* Server and modpack support

---

## How It Works

Creators can make a compendium, add categories, create entries, and attach images directly through the in-game editor.
Entries can then be connected to discoveries, allowing players to unlock information naturally as they explore the world.

An example would be:

Player might discover a forest, ruin, town, dungeon, or landmark. At that point, Lorekeeper can unlock the related entry inside the compendium.

---

## Designed to Fit However You Need It To

Lorekeeper focuses on a clean interface and immersive presentation. You can be as simple or as detailed as you want!

Supports:

* Discovery popups
* Organized browsing
* External assets
* Modpack and server integration
* Creator-controlled progression

---
